full_page.content:
c. 1918 -
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 3.
Pg. 20. "O Lord, the hope of Israel: all that forsake thee shall be confounded . because they have forsaken the Lord, the vein of living waters. Jer. XVII-13
"The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, and in them that hope in His mercy." Ps 146 - 11
Pg. 21. PURITY PRAISED
"O how beautiful is the chaste generation with glory: the memory thereof is immortal: because it is known both with God and with men. When it is present they imitate it and they desire it when it hath withdrawn itself, and it triumpheth crowned forever, winning the reward of undefiled conflicts. (Wis. I -1-2)
Pg. 22. Blank
Pg. 23. MISERABLE END OF THE WICKED
Wis V 1 - IV 20. They shall come with fear at the thought of their sins, and their iniquities shall stand against them to con- vict them. (IV 20).
1. Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them and taken away their labors.
2. These seeing it, shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the suddenness of their salvation.
3. Saying within themselves, repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit: These are they, whom we had sometime in derision.
Pg. 24. Blank
